description: This file implements the OpenCDM (Open Content Decryption Module) interface, including session management, decryption, metadata handling, and system support functions for DRM systems within a media framework.

classes.name: OpenCDMAccessor
classes.description: Singleton class managing DRM sessions, keys, and system interactions.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of OpenCDMAccessor.

methods.name: WaitForKey
methods.description: Waits for a specific key status within a timeout period.

methods.name: Session
methods.description: Retrieves a session object by session ID.

methods.name: AddSession
methods.description: Adds a session to the internal session map.

methods.name: RemoveSession
methods.description: Removes a session from the internal session map.

methods.name: SystemBeingDestructed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a DRM system is being destructed.
